title: recovery drills
system_instruction_addendum: RECOVERY DRILLS ADDENDUM: Synthetic train-wreck on deck B (key clash OR misaligned phrase). User bails out via echo-out, filter, or cut within 4 bars.

drill_shapes.shape: playback-pitch drift on deck b causes harmonic clash with deck a
playback-rate drift on deck b causes phrase misalignment with deck a

tutor_speak.text: i'm going to introduce two problems into your mix, one drill at a time.
when you hear it go off, bail out within four bars: echo-out, filter sweep, or hard cut.

hints.text: load two tracks, get them playing together. i'll introduce drill one when you're settled.
drill one is a key clash. drill two is a phrase misalignment.
tap continue when both drills are recovered.
